name: lukka-predmar
description: Prediction market discovery, taxonomy, volume and open interest. Requires a Lukka account.

interface.longDescription: Lukka Prediction Markets Data MCP. Research prediction market listings, outcomes, PMCS taxonomy, activity, open interest, price history and venue context through Lukka Predmar. Requires a connected Lukka account with Prediction Markets entitlement. Coverage varies by venue and market. Present observed market data with timestamps and sources, without treating market prices as guaranteed probabilities. The connector does not create markets, place wagers or execute trades.
defaultPrompt: Find five Bitcoin prediction markets with venues and outcomes.
Show hourly prediction market open interest over the last day.

prompts: Find up to five available Bitcoin prediction markets and show their venues and outcomes.
Explain the prediction market categories returned by Lukka's PMCS taxonomy.
Show hourly prediction market activity by venue over the last day.
Show hourly prediction market open interest by venue over the last day.
Summarize the latest available prediction market recap and its observation time.

positive.prompt: Find up to five available Bitcoin prediction markets and show their venues and outcomes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use search bitcoin and limit as string 5. Report returned event identifiers, venue and outcomes; do not invent markets or execute a trade.

positive.prompt: Explain the prediction market categories returned by Lukka's PMCS taxonomy.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the taxonomy tool and explain returned hierarchy codes and labels. Do not substitute an invented classification.

positive.prompt: Show hourly prediction market activity by venue over the last day.
positive.expected_behavior: Use paired UTC from/to for a 24-hour window and interval as string 3600000. Report returned per-venue activity and units.

positive.prompt: Show hourly prediction market open interest by venue over the last day.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the same 24-hour UTC window and interval as string 3600000. Identify open interest separately from traded volume.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest available prediction market recap and its observation time.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the recap tool; attribute returned narrative and metrics to their generated/observation times and explicitly report missing coverage.

negative.description: Explain that creating markets is unsupported; do not claim that a market was created.
negative.prompt: Create a new prediction market for my event.

negative.description: Explain that observed market prices do not guarantee an event outcome; do not fabricate certainty.
negative.prompt: Guarantee which outcome will win based on these market prices.

negative.description: Explain that wallet balance queries are outside this server's scope; do not pretend another connector was used.
negative.prompt: Retrieve my wallet balance using this prediction market connector.

publication.release_notes: Removes MCP from public product names to follow OpenAI naming guidelines. Retains the product-specific skills, Lukka website and existing MCP configuration.
